meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: solution_aTFrQkQDgvp7m17er_playbook_af89o
title: Ingest Email to CASE Record (Event)
description: This automation workflow processes incoming phishing emails and deduplicates by message ID, enriches with threat intelligence and KB articles, then creates CASE records for new phishing emails
actions:
  Deduplicate_Email:
    title: Deduplicate Email
    type: connector
    description: >
      Checks if the incoming email has already been processed by searching for existing CASE records with matching email message ID
    on-success:
    - If_New_Email: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_abYvbAetCHL1zMFQl_playbook
    inputs:
      Email_Message_ID: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Email.email_message_id }'
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputSchemaReferenceId: e51eefbe-4de6-45e8-bc11-af334208c0ea
    outputSchemaReferenceId: e7d2d50d-7bf7-4364-bce7-b2e7b34eca36
  If_New_Email:
    title: If New Email
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Conditional branch that proceeds with signal creation only if no matching CASE record exists from deduplication check
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Fix_TEDS_Observables
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Deduplicate_Email.result.published.Matching_CASE_Record_Exists
          - $:eq: false
    else: ""
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 8387e369-e9bd-4799-8ed7-4f9f55372529
    outputSchemaReferenceId: f0509978-e7a4-48b6-ba2b-9d431eedcea7
  Parallel:
    title: Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: Executes observable enrichment and knowledge base article search simultaneously to optimize processing time
    on-success:
    - Create_CASE_Record: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Enrich_Observables
    - Find_Matching_KB_Articles
    actions:
      Find_Matching_KB_Articles:
        title: Find Matching KB Articles
        type: connector
        description: >
          Searches knowledge base for articles matching the phishing email signal based on signal type, name, and subject
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_abEyxZA6VQXXHY4sV_playbook
        inputs:
          Signal_Type: Phishing Email
          Signal_Name: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Email.email_subject }'
          Organization_Name: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Email.email_organization }'
          Signal_Source: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Email.email_provider }'
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: bebe8a64-9ce7-4298-b2a5-4150cfeedb35
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 5be012a1-a7c9-4957-9196-77b922e980ac
      Enrich_Observables:
        title: Enrich Observables
        type: connector
        description: >
          Enriches email observables with threat intelligence data and returns tracking IDs for related threat intelligence records
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_acBotOdQazx2MzaYG_playbook
        inputs:
          Observables:
            $:ref: $actions.Fix_TEDS_Observables.result.published.TEDS_Object.observables
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 56f342fb-ce86-4ca1-9a45-a2d22ca8a51c
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 2f57ec89-8e47-4d2e-b0a0-9280331144da
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: e5d9bb5b-0036-4e62-9b19-da89c2d1d427
    outputSchemaReferenceId: a2ce3efa-f449-412b-aab2-4a1ffb116a3e
  Fix_TEDS_Observables:
    meta: {}
    title: Fix TEDS Observables
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success:
    - Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Processes and standardizes TEDS email object observables to ensure proper formatting for downstream enrichment and analysis
    action: $playbook.component_aWoiw0KHlTJUYAk1x_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      TEDS_Object:
        $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Email
    testInputs: {}
    inputSchemaReferenceId: a6f0cbfb-e80d-4074-9b3b-23a77409add7
    outputSchemaReferenceId: dc64b1d0-f945-4052-8a49-b2c54b6d7bad
  Create_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Create CASE Record
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Creates a phishing signal record combining email data, enriched observables, threat intelligence IDs, and matched KB article IDs
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 8812bc69-5126-433f-8921-854a1204867c
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 952e6845-86df-47a3-8b55-e36acf9d20d1
    action: $playbook.component_abssEn8eu88XgAP_0_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      email:
        $:ref: $actions.Fix_TEDS_Observables.result.published.TEDS_Object
      Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs:
        $:ref: $actions.Enrich_Observables.result.published.Threat_Intelligence_Record_Tracking_IDs
      KB_Article_Tracking_IDs:
        $:ref: $actions.Find_Matching_KB_Articles.result.published.KB_Article_Tracking_IDs
      Extended_Email_Fields:
        $:ref: $event.data.Extended_Fields
      Signal_Type: Phishing Email
      Signal_Source: '{ $:ref: $event.data.TEDS_Email.email_provider }'
    testInputs: {}
triggers:
  flows:
  - Ingest_Email:
      if: true
entrypoints:
- Deduplicate_Email
meta:
  enabled: true
namespace: $default
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
inputs:
  type: object
